Some people command attention without ever asking for it. Christopher Moltisanti was one of them.

There was something about the way he walked into a room, the way he spoke, and the confidence he carried that made every confrontation feel electric. Calm one second, explosive the next, he kept everyone on edge. His ambition, ego, and unpredictability made him one of the most compelling characters in The Sopranos.

No matter who he was standing across from, Christopher always made the scene feel like it could go in any direction.
